$comment: Allowlist of npm-audit advisories that originate ENTIRELY from the Expo SDK
52 / React Native 0.76 / jest-expo build-and-tooling dependency tree.
These are transitive dependencies ProjectTrack does not install directly;
npm's only offered remediation is `expo@44` / `react-native@0.88`, i.e. a
breaking downgrade/upgrade that would wreck the app, so they cannot be fixed
from this repo today. They are tracked here (not silenced globally) so the
mobile audit still FAILS on any NEW advisory outside this known set.
Revisit and prune this list whenever the Expo SDK is upgraded.
Verified pre-existing: present in package-lock.json before the report-
verification feature was added (they are unrelated to expo-location/expo-camera).
